definitions.explanation: Quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences. Can refer to physical sensitivity (skin, allergies) or emotional/social awareness.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{寒|さむ}さに{敏感|びんかん}だ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{人|ひと}の{感情|かんじょう}にとても{敏感|びんかん}だ。
examples.english: She's very sensitive to other people's feelings.

examples.japanese: {敏感|びんかん}{肌|はだ}なので、この{化粧品|けしょうひん}は{使|つか}えない。
examples.english: I have sensitive skin, so I can't use this cosmetic.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes heightened responsiveness to stimuli, whether physical or emotional.
・{敏感|びんかん}な{人|ひと} (a sensitive person)
・{敏感|びんかん}に{反応|はんのう}する (to react sensitively)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{敏感|びんかん}{肌|はだ} (sensitive skin - very common in cosmetic advertising)
・{敏感|びんかん}に{察知|さっち}する (to sense keenly)
・{価格|かかく}に{敏感|びんかん} (price-sensitive)
・{流行|りゅうこう}に{敏感|びんかん} (trend-conscious)

CONTRAST:
・{敏感|びんかん} ↔ {鈍感|どんかん} (sensitive ↔ insensitive)

NOTE:
Unlike the often negative connotation of "sensitive" in English (oversensitive, touchy), {敏感|びんかん} is neutral to positive, implying awareness and responsiveness.
